actor_instance: Codex GPT-6, MFM source and architecture review
goal: Prepare the first native foundation data route without promoting a text-only pilot to the full personal MFM.
procedure: Freeze exact public source candidates and the N0 source evidence without inheriting training admission. On an internet-capable CPU environment, verify each selected Hugging Face file against its pinned repository object ID; stream full source shards into unadmitted, source-bound review candidates; hash transfer receipts and reconcile exact duplicates and exclusions across shards. Require a separate recorded rights/privacy review and source-admission manifest before optimizer input. Review a proposed trainer against all required text, image, audio, video, long-history and evidence-pointer paths. Reject the trainer if it only trains next-token text/JSON, lacks sharding or restart, or trusts self-declared fresh-init ancestry. Record the rejection and continue the full architecture rather than buying GPUs for a pilot.
authority: Reproducible public method and code review only. No actual public source was fetched or admitted, no legal grant independently authenticated, no native foundation/MFM weight was trained, and no GPU purchase was authorized.
validation: The source pin matched SHA-256 8bfbc11a; 66 existing formation tests, four legacy staging tests and eleven native source/pipeline CPU tests passed in the MFM checkout. Independent read-only review rejected the incomplete trainer. The new acquisition path has not run against a live pinned Parquet shard or Magnolia transfer.
failure_or_lesson: A fresh-init text Transformer plus JSON next-token specialization is still a pilot when MFM requires sensory perception, source selection, long-history fusion, typed evidence pointers and a measured scalable full step. Publish source and review primitives with explicit limits; do not disguise a partial trainer as the full model.
